data.name: Cube Crawler
data.detailed_description:
Games by FreeTimeDevelopment

Created by a passionate solo indie game developer from Germany.

Overview

Manipulate gigantic cube-shaped dungeons in this sci-fi action roguelite. Shift rooms, discover hidden paths and fight your way deeper into the Cube to uncover the truth behind its existence.

A Living Cube (Dungeons)

Every dungeon is a gigantic cube made up of interconnected rooms. But the Cube is not static.

Shift rooms across the edges of the Cube, create new paths and discover hidden areas. Every action changes the dungeon itself.

The deeper you go, the stronger the Cube reacts to your presence.

Build Your Own Spaceship

Do not simply choose a ship — build your own.

Combine hull, weapon and engine to create your personal build. Different ship parts affect stats, gameplay feel, attack style and survivability.

Whether you prefer a fast fighter, a durable tank or an aggressive damage build: your ship defines how you challenge the Cube.

Room Modules are YOUR key.

Find special Room Modules and reshape the dungeon.

New paths appear. Old connections disappear. Hidden rooms become reachable.

But every decision changes your future route.

Use the Cube’s structure to your advantage and find the activation room to unlock powerful long-term abilities.

The Cube Evolves

The longer you remain inside the Cube, the more dangerous it becomes.

Monsters level up, develop new attack patterns and turn even familiar rooms into deadly threats.

The Cube is watching you.

Fragments, Activation and the Path to the Center

Fragments, activation rooms and clues about a deeper origin are hidden within the Cube.

Collect Gate Fragments, activate the Cube and prepare for the descent into its center. Because eventually, your journey will no longer lead only through the dungeon — but into its heart.

Create Your Own Playstyle

Combine active and passive equipment to further shape your build. Discover powerful equipment with different rarity tiers:

Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary.

Every run offers new combinations, risks and possibilities.

Rewards, Traders and Progression

Collect Cube Coins during your runs, discover valuable equipment and use trader rooms and special rooms to improve your build strategically.

Dark Matter and activated Cubes provide long-term progression through the skill tree and unlock new possibilities for future runs.

Discover the Truth Behind the Cube

You are not the first.

Between the rooms lie traces of previous pilots, lost artifacts and fragments of a truth that should never have been discovered.

What is the Cube really?

Explore Six Unique Sectors

Each side of the Cube features its own style, enemies and atmosphere.

  • Entrance — technical and controlled

  • Passway — cold and mysterious

  • High Area — dangerous and mechanical

  • Danger Sector — unstable and aggressive

  • Cross Over — chaotic and action-packed

  • Cube Center — alive and disturbing

One Seed. Endless Possibilities.

The seed system allows exact reproduction of a Cube while encounters and room contents continue to evolve. Test new routes, discover alternative strategies and challenge yourself.

Or share your seed with friends and compare your decisions inside the same Cube.

Statistics or Memory? Your Universe Grows With Every Run

Every explored Cube becomes part of your personal universe. Track your greatest explorations, revisit known seeds and improve your routes with new builds and abilities.

Key Features

  • Manipulate gigantic cube-shaped dungeons

  • Shift rooms and create new paths

  • Build your own spaceship from hull, weapon and engine

  • Sci-fi action roguelite with a unique dungeon structure

  • Active and passive equipment with rarity tiers

  • Dynamic difficulty through escalating monsters

  • Gate Fragments, activation and the planned descent into the Cube Center

  • Six unique sectors with their own atmosphere

  • Many different room types: bosses, treasures, equipment, traders, ...

  • Permanent progression through the skill tree system

  • Long-term progression

  • Seed system for replayable Cubes

  • Secrets, artifacts and hidden lore

  • Optimized for controller and keyboard

Early Access

New content, enemies, systems, equipment, fragments, the final descent into the center of the Cube and additional secrets will continue to be expanded throughout Early Access.

data.short_description: Explore gigantic cube-shaped dungeons in this unique 3D sci-fi action roguelite. Manipulate their structure with Room Modules, open new paths, uncover hidden secrets, discover powerful technologies, and reveal the origin of these mysterious cubes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300 (4 Cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (6 Cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
